newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained lightly quoted on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the exchange said. No barges traded Friday versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, Lift top, St Louis, Mississippi River, on station, no bid, offer 110 percent.
Due to the Chicago Board of Trade closure on Monday, February 17, in observance of U.S. President's Day, the St Louis Exchange said it will be closed and there will be no call session.
